archetypes.name: handoff-flow
archetypes.rationale: Marker handoff and sentinel ownership are the highest-risk behavior change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 16-17 wrapper, Step 17 no-print mode, and SKILL.md instructions as one handoff protocol. Focus on stale summary suppression, marker balance, and .step17-printed versus .step17-emitted ownership. Check that failure paths still reach Step 18 without hiding Tool Failures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-portability
archetypes.rationale: The change adds Bash control flow around best-effort failures and checksum handoff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell changes for Bash 3.2 portability and errexit behavior. Pay special attention to rc capture around final-report write, best-effort Slack and Step 16 handling, and whether any command substitution or test can abort unexpectedly under set -euo pipefail. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
